launch_networking_process: launch a websocket networking process that handles client connections and keyframe streaming for human-in-the-loop control
terminate_networking_process: terminate the running websocket networking process and clean up all active client connections
NetworkManager_handle_connection: handle incoming websocket client connections by assigning user slots and receiving client state messages
NetworkManager_send_keyframes: send consolidated keyframes to connected websocket clients in a continuous loop with frequency limiting
start_http_availability_server: start an HTTP server that reports server availability status and current user connection count
